An '''aerial bombardment''' was a tactic utilized by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] were unable to deploy more of [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighters]] due to an aerial bombardment of Geonosian [[Launch hive/Legends|launch hive]]s by [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] commanded by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] that took place during the arena rescue.<ref name="ITW:AOTC" />
